h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Tiruvottiyur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Tiruvottiyur

items.pText: Tiruvottiyur, on the northern seafront of Chennai, mixes older streets, industrial units near the ports and newer apartment blocks. Builders here need a play area that holds up to inspection when the flats are handed over to the residents' association. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for these projects, and for schools and parks, at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,050 km away.

The area comes under the Greater Chennai Corporation and shares the city's hot, humid weather and north-east monsoon from October to December. Sites close to the shore also get salt air. We send equipment by road and install through our own team or a dealer in south India. Share the size of the play area and your expected handover month, and we will plan the order around that date.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: What a builder should hand over with the play area

c: When a residents' association takes charge of the play area, it needs papers as well as equipment. Keep the approved layout drawing, the list of pieces and the warranty terms in the handover file. Note our after-sales number,
, so the association knows whom to call.

The warranty runs for 3 years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and 1 year on springs, bearings and spare parts. It covers manufacturing defects when the equipment is maintained as per our instructions, so pass those instructions on too. Near the sea, the association should rinse the equipment regularly. items.q: How should a seafront society look after its playground?
items.a: Rinse the equipment with fresh water from time to time to clear salt, check bolts and seats regularly and follow the maintenance steps we share at handover.
